label: PF Backlog 533
title: Parallel batch grooming: bounded concurrent LLM calls (groom-all --jobs)
body:
## Problem
Bulk grooming runs its LLM batches sequentially: 33 items at batch 3 = 11 sequential calls, each ~1-2.5 min dominated by model latency -> ~15-25 min wall time. The calls are independent, so they can run concurrently.

## Goal
Add bounded concurrency to groom-all so independent batches run in parallel, capped by the existing LLM-client rate budget, cutting wall time (e.g. 4 concurrent -> ~1/3-1/4 of the time).

## In scope
- groom_all(jobs=N): ThreadPoolExecutor over batch chunks; writes applied sequentially (single writer)
- config grooming-guidelines.parallel (default 4) + --jobs flag (CLI + API)
- keep the LLM-client rate budget (_pace, thread-safe) as the global cap
- tests

## Out of scope
- distributed/worker-pool grooming
- changing the model or rate budget

## Acceptance
- groom-all --jobs N runs N batches concurrently; results/writes are correct and deterministic-fallback per item.
- default from config; --jobs overrides; rate budget still applied.
- tests pass.
